description: Tell Hydrafetch whether an earlier result was accurate. Use it after a scrape, search or other call returns missing, wrong or blocked content, so it gets looked at; a good rating is welcome too. Pass the requestId from that call's usage block, or the URL it read.

reasons.description: What was wrong, for a bad rating.

requestId.description: usage.requestId from the call being rated.

url.description: The URL that call read, when the requestId is not to hand.

name: feedback
title: Rate a result
